Maintenance uncertainty band and optional 5%/150-kcal adjustments are product heuristics, not weight-change predictions.
nutrition.substitutions: Preview a catalog-backed alternative, compare portions and totals, then approve a new version. Dietary additions take effect before suggestions. Remove profile restrictions only through profile editing. Choose certified halal poultry; no record certifies a product.
nutrition.training_note: Distribute carbohydrate-containing meals around training according to comfort; keep regular protein across the day. Recovery days still need fuel. No automatic extra calories are added for a session. Reported timing preferences do not edit the approved training calendar.
nutrition.budget_note: Editorial cost tiers guide ingredient choices; no live local prices or monetary budget guarantee.
